en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional bride-abduction song. 'гу' and 'вадив' are dialect forms; 'Идете си' I read as 'go away'.

lines.cyr: Грабиле гу, ајде џанам, Ангелину,
lines.lat: Grabile gu, ajde džanam, Angelinu,
lines.en: They abducted her, come on my dear, Angelina,

lines.cyr: грабиле гу, ајде џанам, од сред село.
lines.lat: grabile gu, ajde džanam, od sred selo.
lines.en: they abducted her, come on my dear, from the middle of the village.

lines.cyr: Од сред село, ајде џанам, од собори
lines.lat: Od sred selo, ajde džanam, od sobori
lines.en: From the middle of the village, come on my dear, from the gathering,

lines.cyr: од собори, ајде џанам, велигденски.
lines.lat: od sobori, ajde džanam, veligdenski.
lines.en: from the gathering, come on my dear, of Easter.

lines.cyr: Па дочуле, ајде џанам, девет брата,
lines.lat: Pa dočule, ajde džanam, devet brata,
lines.en: Then they heard, come on my dear, nine brothers,

lines.cyr: па земале, ајде џанам, секирете.
lines.lat: pa zemale, ajde džanam, sekirete.
lines.en: then they took, come on my dear, the axes.

lines.cyr: Па отишле, ајде џанам, да гу вадив,
lines.lat: Pa otišle, ajde džanam, da gu vadiv,
lines.en: Then they went, come on my dear, to get her out,

lines.cyr: да гу вадив, ајде џанам, Ангелину.
lines.lat: da gu vadiv, ajde džanam, Angelinu.
lines.en: to get her out, come on my dear, Angelina.

lines.cyr: Па видела, ајде џанам, стара мајка,
lines.lat: Pa videla, ajde džanam, stara majka,
lines.en: Then she saw, come on my dear, the old mother,

lines.cyr: па викнала, ајде џанам, по синови:
lines.lat: pa viknala, ajde džanam, po sinovi:
lines.en: then she called out, come on my dear, to her sons:

lines.cyr: - Чујете ли, ајде џанам, девет сина,
lines.lat: - Čujete li, ajde džanam, devet sina,
lines.en: - Do you hear, come on my dear, nine sons,

lines.cyr: оставете, ајде џанам, секирете.
lines.lat: ostavete, ajde džanam, sekirete.
lines.en: put down, come on my dear, the axes.

lines.cyr: Ја ќе иду, ајде џанам, да гу прашам,
lines.lat: Ja ḱe idu, ajde džanam, da gu prašam,
lines.en: I will go, come on my dear, to ask her,

lines.cyr: дал' е силом, ајде џанам, ели милом.
lines.lat: dal' e silom, ajde džanam, eli milom.
lines.en: whether it is by force, come on my dear, or willingly.

lines.cyr: Па отиде, ајде џанам, стара мајка,
lines.lat: Pa otide, ajde džanam, stara majka,
lines.en: Then she went, come on my dear, the old mother,

lines.cyr: па прашуе, ајде џанам, Ангелину.
lines.lat: pa prašue, ajde džanam, Angelinu.
lines.en: then she asked, come on my dear, Angelina.

lines.cyr: - Кажи, кажи, мила ќерко, Ангелино,
lines.lat: - Kaži, kaži, mila ḱerko, Angelino,
lines.en: - Tell me, tell me, dear daughter Angelina,

lines.cyr: дал' си силом, мила ќерко, ели милом?
lines.lat: dal' si silom, mila ḱerko, eli milom?
lines.en: are you here by force, dear daughter, or willingly?

lines.cyr: - Идете си, стара мајко, не сам силом,
lines.lat: - Idete si, stara majko, ne sam silom,
lines.en: - Go away, old mother, it is not by force,

lines.cyr: јас сам милом, стара мајко, доведена.
lines.lat: jas sam milom, stara majko, dovedena.
lines.en: it is willingly, old mother, that I was brought.
